LanguageData.DMS_SubsonicTrauma.label: infrasonic trauma
LanguageData.DMS_SubsonicTrauma.description: Tuned infrasound has set this creature's inner ear and viscera resonating. It causes nausea, disorientation and deep, diffuse pain that no wound explains. The keener a creature's hearing, the harder it is hit; a deaf creature is unaffected. Repeated exposure stacks up quickly, and at its worst the pain alone is enough to cause shock.\n\nThe effect fades on its own within a couple of hours.
LanguageData.DMS_SubsonicTrauma.stages.0.label: discomfort
LanguageData.DMS_SubsonicTrauma.stages.1.label: disoriented
LanguageData.DMS_SubsonicTrauma.stages.2.label: agonizing
LanguageData.DMS_SubsonicModule.label: infrasonic module
LanguageData.DMS_SubsonicModule.description: A tuned infrasound emitter array mounted on the hull. It lets the mech release a burst of infrasound that wracks nearby living enemies with pain and panic.
LanguageData.DMS_InfrasoundRupture.label: infrasonic rupture
LanguageData.DMS_InfrasoundRupture.description: Tissue torn apart from the inside by resonating infrasound. Left untreated, it can scar into permanent hearing loss.
